svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 92 x 76 mm, 1.5 mm aluminium; deburr all edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Window 30 x 30 mm over the IMU, centred 5 mm right of centre:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drill 6 mm in each corner, cut between with a piercing saw, file.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fixing holes: four 4.5 mm, 80 x 40 mm apart, matching the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Module holes: 3.2 mm; mark them through each module (about

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 23 x 33 mm for the converter, 45 x 19 mm for the controller).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tie slots: two 2 x 3 mm, 15.5 mm forward of centre, 24 and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 32 mm right of centre, for the supercapacitor's cable tie.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: sits on the four hex standoffs 8 mm above the box floor,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: held by four M4 x 6 screws; 1.5 mm clear of the walls and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pillars, 4.5 mm clear of the gland locknut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: drops onto the standoffs without touching a wall.
